title: Coast Guard rescues boater after skiff capsizes near Red Fish Bay
description: An aircrew from Air Station Corpus Christi rescues a person in distress after his 18-foot skiff capsized due to weather near Red Fish Bay, Texas, Aug. 20, 2025. The individual was hoisted into the air station’s MH-65 Dolphin helicopter and transported to Air Station Corpus Christi. (U.S. Coast Guard courtesy asset Air Station Corpus Christi)
